findings.title: No organization/customer entity: independent-firm SaaS tenancy is not modeled
findings.violated_requirement: none for approved P0 (workspaces+matters only); this bounds future multi-firm claims
findings.tenant_boundary: tenant key in code+DB+API = workspace_id (+ matter_id confidentiality). Identity = provisioned (idp_issuer, idp_subject) with UNIQUE constraint. One person may hold memberships in many workspaces; one workspace holds many matters; one ZITADEL issuer can host many independent customer workspaces with no boundary between them.
findings.impact: what separates two customer firms today is operational convention (separate deployments/issuers per firm), not a product boundary. Organization lifecycle, per-firm backup/export, residency, billing domain, org-level admin: all absent.
findings.smallest_fix: policy decision first: either document 'one deployment (or one issuer+workspace tree) per customer firm' as the tenancy model, or add an organization entity with workspace.org_id and membership inheritance. Do not retrofit silently.
findings.regression: none needed now; add tenant-model tests when the decision lands

findings.confidence: source-confirmed on corrected bytes (defense-in-depth only; no API bypass reproduced)
findings.title: Review-matrix storage invariants enforced by service only (three gaps)
findings.violated_requirement: defense-in-depth expectations recorded by the earlier verifier; unchanged by the rework
findings.location: migrations_mattercontrol/0008_review_matrix.sql: review_answers.supersedes_id FK is global (REFERENCES review_answers(id)) not (grid,version,question)-scoped; review_question_revisions FK is question_id-only (no matter/grid scoping); review_answers.question_revision has no FK/CHECK tying it to an existing revision row
findings.impact: a hypothetical non-service writer (manual SQL, future bulk path, a buggy migration) could persist structurally invalid rows the service layer would then render. The Matter lock + server-side predecessor/revision selection make this unreachable through the API (PG race suite PASS).
findings.smallest_fix: add composite FKs/partial unique + CHECK in a new migration when convenient; do not alter immutable 0008
findings.regression: PG contract test asserting the new constraints

findings.title: No retention policy executor for command_receipts.purge_after and security_audit_events
findings.violated_requirement: TB-06 (retention value) is an open PO decision — correctly left null in schema
findings.location: 0001_mattercontrol_core.sql: command_receipts.purge_after TIMESTAMPTZ (nullable, no default, no purge job); security_audit_events has no retention column
findings.impact: receipts grow unbounded in production until a policy + job exist; a privacy/ops item for deployment, not a correctness defect
findings.smallest_fix: PO decision on retention; then a bounded purge job + index

findings.title: Local people directory is correctly bounded today but becomes cross-workspace org discovery if enabled without an org boundary
findings.violated_requirement: none — PO-authorized bounded local/dev scope (prompt-recognized exception)
findings.location: config/product.go:85 (default false); productapi/handlers.go:18-29 (gate); queries_mattercontrol/matter.sql:177-190 (same-issuer + workspace-OWNER + excludes-active-members + LIMIT 20)
findings.impact: if MC_LOCAL_PEOPLE_DIRECTORY=true in production, a workspace OWNER can discover any provisioned user name on the same issuer across all workspaces. That is the approved local behavior, not a defect; it must not be enabled for independent firms on a shared issuer until SYR-F01's boundary exists.
findings.smallest_fix: deployment guardrail: refuse the flag outside loopback/dev (like MC_OBJECT_BACKEND=fs does with K_SERVICE), or gate per-issuer config
findings.regression: config test asserting the deployment guard once decided
